scope: re-audit of PREV-B01 through PREV-B06 and PREV-N01 through PREV-N07
frame and decision binding against archived entropy
path traversal, symlink escape, and output check-to-write race behavior
incomplete adjudication projection, ambiguity, and sparse zero multiplicities
focused tests, lint, formatting, typing, and CLI availability

prior_finding_disposition.evidence: The v3 implementation has a genuine secrets.token_bytes(32) path and HMAC-SHA256 within-stratum ranking, but the public CLI also accepts arbitrary --seed-file bytes and records them as provided_prelabel_seed_256.
The estimator now verifies legacy v2 decision bindings and rejects fixed-salt v2 frames. It cannot parse the actual v3 decision or frame, and no independent v3 rank/selection replay verifier exists.
Ordinary traversal and semantic/gate-like output names are rejected, but an escaped reports/prevalence root symlink is accepted and a check-to-write directory-swap race wrote outside the repository.
Both the estimator projection and FrameItemV3 now validate cluster, representative, contributor, multiplicity, stratum, and content-ID coherence; adversarial internal tampering failed.
Exactly one adjudication projection row is required per frame item and explicit unresolved is accounted separately from missing; the incomplete-projection adversarial test failed closed.
Decision, frame, and adjudication inputs are each read once, hashed from those bytes, and parsed from the same buffers. Output publication still has a separate check-to-write race under PREV-RA-B04.
An all-ambiguous census now reports an undefined binary denominator with null interval bounds.
Sparse family and source-proxy maps reject nonpositive entries and must sum exactly to member_count.
Nonresponse reports respondent-Hajek descriptive point estimation and an explicit respondent-only scope.

adjudication_id is unique within a projection and the projection bytes are hash-bound, but records still do not carry a content-derived ID or a typed upstream annotation/adjudication-manifest binding.
The re-audit verified frame lineage and label-blind fields, but did not establish an independent actual-read audit for every tranche decision input.

Service-level output rejection and overwrite tests exist and CLI help works. A full CLI happy-path, missing-input, and exit-code integration test against a real v3 frame cannot exist until v3 estimator support is implemented.
Primary exact inversion supports singleton noncertainty strata; secondary Taylor intervals explicitly report unsupported status and retain only the descriptive point estimate.

confirmed_blockers.problem: The estimator cannot consume the prospective randomized v3 decision or frame.
confirmed_blockers.evidence: An actual synthetic FrameFreezeDecisionV3 plus FrameItemV3 frame produced by freeze_frame_v3 was passed to load_verified_v2_frame_projection_bytes and failed with 37 ExpansionDecisionV2 validation errors. The loader imports only ExpansionDecisionV2 and FrameItemV2. The report policy and PrevalenceInputBinding still require frame_schema_version=2, and the input-binding decision regex expects lf021_expansion_decision_v3 while the real prefix is lf021_frame_freeze_decision_v3.
confirmed_blockers.impact: Legacy v2 frames correctly fail because they are fixed-salt, while valid randomized v3 frames also fail. Therefore no real design-based prevalence report can currently be produced.
confirmed_blockers.required_correction: Add an explicit schema-dispatching verified loader for FrameFreezeDecisionV3 and FrameItemV3; migrate the report input schema to represent frame schema 3 and the actual decision ID; keep v2 loading only to issue the fixed-salt rejection. Add one end-to-end v3 frame plus complete adjudication plus report CLI test.

confirmed_blockers.problem: There is no independent loader that replays v3 population membership, seed provenance, HMAC ranks, stratum allocation, and selected units from the bound decision.
confirmed_blockers.evidence: A real v3 frame row was given an arbitrary wrong sampling_rank_digest; after recomputing its row, frame, and decision content IDs, FrameItemV3, FrameBindingV3, and FrameFreezeDecisionV3 all validated even though the digest differed from the archived seed. This is expected of self-consistency schemas but proves that parsing alone is not verification.
confirmed_blockers.impact: A future estimator fix that merely parses v3 schemas would accept a self-consistent forged sample and invalid inclusion probabilities.
confirmed_blockers.required_correction: Implement load_verified_frame_freeze_v3 that verifies repository-confined policy, implementation, v2-stop, population, seed bytes and provenance bindings; replays v2 observations and the eligible population; recomputes allocation and every HMAC rank; requires the supplied frame to equal the selected set; and returns the estimator projection only after exact replay.

confirmed_blockers.problem: The production CLI permits a caller-chosen 32-byte seed while labeling the design CSPRNG SRS.
confirmed_blockers.evidence: scripts/30_freeze_lf021_frame_v3.py exposes --seed-file. archive_sampling_seed_v3 accepts any 32 bytes, including bytes(range(32)) in the test, and marks source=provided_prelabel_seed_256 without evidence that the value was random or unpredictable when the population was known.
confirmed_blockers.impact: An operator can search or choose a seed after seeing the label-blind population to favor particular units. Pre-label timing alone does not make that a probability sample, so exact design-based intervals are not justified.
confirmed_blockers.required_correction: For scientific runs, require the OS-CSPRNG single-draw path or a separately verified external-randomness-beacon schema. Remove --seed-file from the production CLI; keep deterministic seed injection only in a test-only/internal API guarded from release artifacts. The independent verifier must reject non-approved seed sources.

confirmed_blockers.problem: Prevalence output confinement is vulnerable to a symlinked namespace root and a directory-swap check-to-write race.
confirmed_blockers.evidence: When repo/reports/prevalence was a symlink to an external directory, validate_prevalence_output_path accepted the external resolved path. In a controlled adversarial test, swapping an already validated child directory to an external symlink between exists() and write_bytes() caused the report to be written outside the repository. Ordinary ../ traversal was rejected.
confirmed_blockers.impact: The command can escape its promised non-gating repository namespace and may overwrite or create operational files elsewhere.
confirmed_blockers.required_correction: Require the canonical reports/prevalence root itself to remain beneath the canonical repository root and reject symlink components. Publish through a directory file descriptor using no-follow semantics and atomic create/replace, then fsync and re-verify the final inode/path; or stage in a trusted directory and atomically rename without following symlinks. Add static-root-symlink and race regression tests.

important_nonblocking_issues.problem: Frame-freeze v3 accepts and emits absolute artifact bindings whenever output_root is outside the repository, while the estimator's repository verifier requires relative bindings.
important_nonblocking_issues.correction: Constrain scientific v3 output to the registered repository artifact root or define one explicit content-addressed external-store URI scheme supported consistently by generator and verifier.

important_nonblocking_issues.problem: The adjudication projection is file-hash-bound but not typed against an immutable full-adjudication manifest, annotator/adjudicator protocol version, or deterministic content-derived projection IDs.
important_nonblocking_issues.correction: Add a versioned adjudication-projection manifest with source annotation bindings, projection algorithm/version, record count, and content-derived unique record IDs before publication-quality reporting.

important_nonblocking_issues.problem: Frame-freeze output creation uses check-then-write immutability helpers and a check-then-create population seed lock, which are not process-atomic.
important_nonblocking_issues.correction: Use exclusive atomic creation for immutable artifacts and the by-population seed lock; tolerate identical concurrent writers and fail closed on divergent content without leaving an ambiguous canonical lock.

important_nonblocking_issues.problem: The v3 test suite validates generation and tampering but does not exercise a post-persistence independent decision/frame verifier because none exists.
important_nonblocking_issues.correction: Make verifier tests separate from generation tests and include forged policy, implementation, population, seed, rank, allocation, frame-count, path-traversal, and symlink cases.

important_nonblocking_issues.problem: The secondary adjudication/source-manifest provenance and remaining full CLI exit-code coverage are still incomplete.
important_nonblocking_issues.correction: Complete these after PREV-RA-B01 and PREV-RA-B02 make a genuine v3 end-to-end report possible.

validated_strengths.description: Fixed-salt v2 frames fail closed and are not silently treated as probability samples.
V3 freezes the full eligible problem-group by alpha-identity population before its default OS-CSPRNG seed draw and uses deterministic HMAC-SHA256 replay from archived seed bytes.
V3 population items strongly validate scientific keys, representative fields, contributor sets, multiplicities, stratum identity, and content-derived IDs.
Incomplete adjudication projection, zero sparse multiplicities, and internally incoherent frame rows fail closed.
All-ambiguous terminal samples preserve ambiguity and report the binary estimand as undefined rather than inventing a point or interval.
Direct estimator inputs are read once and the report binds decision, frame, seed-provenance, adjudication, and policy hashes.
Ordinary path traversal, gate-like output paths, divergent overwrites, and fixed-salt frames are rejected.
The estimator does not create labels, change supervision eligibility, or close Gate 5g or Gate 5.

targeted_adversarial_pytest.command: uv run pytest -q incomplete-projection zero-multiplicity all-ambiguous population-coherence seed-binding focused nodes

ruff_check.command: uv run ruff check on prevalence, report CLI, frame-freeze v3, script, and focused tests

ruff_format.command: uv run ruff format --check on prevalence, report CLI, frame-freeze v3, script, and focused tests
